summary: A2Z Cust2Mate Solutions furnished a 6-K supplementing its prior report on the completed acquisition by wholly owned subsidiary A2Z Advanced Solutions Ltd. of all outstanding shares of Israeli target Heidia Ltd. from O. Gal Enterprises Ltd. Base consideration is NIS 25,292,000 cash (subject to adjustments) plus 833,333 A2Z common shares, with up to NIS 20,000,000 in additional cash tied to 2027-2028 revenues, plus a NIS 13,691,000 pre-closing dividend to the seller. The 833,333 unregistered shares release in tranches through October 2029, with forfeiture for indemnity or performance shortfalls. Watch earnout attainment and lock-up overhang.
